No other paths. No implementation children, pushes, PRs, merges, parent mutation or peer polling. Propose a concrete seam to root if these paths cannot support the correction; continue independent owned work meanwhile.

Preserve public GameView/PanelView/UiActions APIs, IDs/actions/command keys, native disabled semantics, tab/focus/storage intent, panel scroll continuity, deliberate Resume/capture, every warning/error/result/call string and active/wall-clock lifetime, live-region announcement rules, hidden-HUD persistence/graphics availability and export access. No new subtitles/helper paragraphs. Meaningful tests must retain behavior; do not merely rewrite expected markup or duplicate CSS declarations in tests.

Use a coherent layout with content-sized space for notices and actionable content. Prefer normal layout flow/grid or private grouping over another isolated pixel offset or prompt-count patch. Exact CSS/grouping choice is yours within the ownership. In panel mode allocate actual space for the full notices, including graphics status, rather than floating them over recipe/cargo rows. In playing mode ensure warnings, full result, target/preview, look fallback and pilot/obstruction guidance compose with real content heights, including no-prompt states. Preserve uncluttered ordinary exploration and the existing no-error preparation efficiency. Only changing z-index or pointer events does not fix obscured text; scroll/reflow may support exceptional panel errors but must remain accessible and preserve focus.
